description: Greenhouse Job Board CLI — query any company's public Greenhouse job board from the command line. Generic board_token, no auth required, 4 operations covering jobs, departments, and offices.

novel_features.name: Generic board_token
novel_features.description: Single CLI serves any company that uses Greenhouse Job Board (Stripe, Anthropic, Airbnb, Notion, Figma, etc.) — board_token is a positional argument, not a hardcoded prefix.

novel_features.name: Engine Resource Rename
novel_features.description: Renamed the auto-scaffolded 'greenhouse-job-board-jobs' resource to 'jobs' to fix an engine shadow-rename caused by the 'jobs/' cobra conflict. Recorded in .printing-press-patches/001-rename-jobs-resource.json so regens preserve it.
